controller_preflight_note: Environment-report collection was adjusted to handle a lazily loaded native Merkle module and built-in Decimal. These were controller metadata errors before any replay; no frozen source or binary was edited.
limits: Replay establishes this computation/comparison only; it is not a proof-assistant certificate or independent qualification of the runtime.
Authentication is against hashes and lineage recorded in the supplied artifacts, not an external historical execution attestation.

method.calculation: Unchanged frozen campaign.worker, fresh spawn process per cell, two workers per case, three cases concurrently.
method.environment_capture: Separate processes using the same executable and frozen initialization; environment captured before production audit and after replay in comparison. Workers verify the full source-and-binary fingerprint before and after computation.
method.layer_validation: Unchanged frozen campaign.py --verify-layer in a separate process after each layer, before downstream use.
method.namespaces: Original run IDs retained solely to reproduce scientific time-atom identities. Outputs are isolated verification artifacts, not replacements for production.
method.parent_inputs: First replay layer reads authenticated production base payloads. Later layers read only newly computed replay payloads, using their actual receipt and payload hashes.
method.provenance: Raw provenance hashes are compared without editing. Parent receipt hashes change because receipts and complete payloads include timing/resource metadata. The report lists full raw production/replay provenance and separately checks equality excluding only the parents field.
method.views: Unchanged campaign.views, artifacts.Encoder and artifacts.canonical_hash. Exact SHA-256 comparison; no tolerance.

normalization.name: A22-provenance-without-parent-receipts-v1
normalization.operation: Delete only the top-level parents field; retain every other field without substitution.
normalization.serialization: UTF-8 of Python json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False). No trailing newline.
normalization.independent_checker: VERIFY.py; Python standard library only; no engine import.
normalization.scope: Establishes equality of all non-parent provenance fields. Does not assert equality of the raw parent receipt digests or replace authentication of parent scientific data.
normalization.aggregate_convention: SHA-256 of the same canonical JSON serialization of [{preparation,lane,sha256}, ...], sorted lexicographically by preparation then lane.
